title: Introducing the Updated CLEAR App
summary: Get everything you need, exactly when you need it from home to gate with the upgraded CLEAR App: When to leave for the airport and what to expect when you get there, plus CLEAR+ Lane directions just one tap to book CLEAR Concierge.
body_markdown:
The travel day can be overwhelming—we’re here to help with the upgraded CLEAR App. With this new release, you’ll enjoy a brand new experience as the app automatically switches from what you need before leaving for the airport to surfacing the most important information once you arrive.


Know exactly when to leave and have a great experience when you get there with the premier travel app—all in one personalized view that adapts to your travel day. Download or open the app before your next trip and enjoy total control from home to gate.
‍


## **Before You Leave**


To start the travel day, the CLEAR App will help you know exactly when to leave, based on real-time traffic, airport conditions, and your preferred arrival time. Reserve your Uber ride directly in the app and book CLEAR Concierge on the way for a stress-free airport experience.
‍


## **At the Airport**


The upgraded CLEAR App adapts to your travel day and will begin surfacing the most important information you need at the airport, as soon as you arrive. Get directions to the CLEAR+ Lane and view live security wait times, so you can enjoy peace-of-mind as you move through the airport.
‍


## **Make the Most of Your Time at the Airport**


Explore exclusive airport tips directly from CLEAR Ambassadors, and in select airports, you can pre-order your Starbucks to have it ready and waiting for pickup on the way to your gate. No more stressing over waiting in line for your coffee or finding the right location to order from—you pick your favorites, and we’ll take care of the rest.
‍


## **Your Best Travel Day Yet With the CLEAR App**


We know the travel day can be overwhelming, which is why we’ve obsessed over upgrading the CLEAR App to help you enjoy your best possible experience. From planning your travel day to getting everything you need, exactly when you need it along the way, the upgraded CLEAR App has you covered on your next trip—from home to gate and back again.


[Download the CLEAR App](https://www.clearme.com/clear-mobile-app) and take control of your travel days.


‍
